gaps.finding: The Agenda sheet and the two Calendar sheets disagree on days 7-9. Agenda: Day 7 "Handling Issues and Escalations + End of Engagement", Day 8 "Add-on Process Review", Day 9 "Intro to Front Office and G5". Calendar: Day 7 "End of Engagement Add-on Process Review", Day 8 "All About Conversions", Day 9 "Intro to RPA + Front Office + G5". The two Calendar sheets also disagree with each other on which sessions are recordings.

The Reference table lists 21 products. RUM / RUSM is not among them, and neither dependency document states a OneSite prerequisite for it. Its position in the sequence comes only from the Project Planning Process deck, slide 3.
